title: AAB size audit (77.7MB is too heavy for Egyptian prepaid data)
steps: Run flutter build appbundle --analyze-size and identify top offenders
Check assets/exercises/gifs, lottie, scene packs, food_db JSONs for compression/webp/lazy-load opportunities
Convert large PNG/GIF assets to webp/animated webp or lottie where possible
Consider deferred components or on-demand download for scene packs
acceptance: AAB size reduced measurably; report includes top 10 assets by size
App still builds and all scenes render
